about: This pack stores no data. There is no database. The page is rendered from one typed content file written from the brief at build time.

holds: sections in order, each with its status (drafted or placeholder)
FAQ, testimonials, footer columns and legal links

rules: Page content lives only in the content file. It is not editable in a screen; changes are made by asking the builder.

Each price is defined once, as the owner-typed monthly price. Yearly price = floor(monthly x 12 x (1 - discount)). Per-month equivalent on the yearly plan = floor(yearly / 12). Everything that shows a price (cards, FAQ, comparison table) reads these values; none is typed a second time.
A section with status 'placeholder' shows a small 'Sample' label on the page and appears in the brief's placeholders list.
A link with no value shows as 'Set your link' in the review list and points to the top of the page or the closing section until set.
